47f326e3ab22af0b68f4.en: Use commas to separate items in a list. The last two items are joined by and.
47f326e3ab22af0b68f4.id: Pakai koma untuk memisahkan hal-hal dalam daftar. Dua hal terakhir digabung dengan and.

fb1a19e1973f2ed496fc.en: Put a comma after a fronted adverbial or an opening clause.
fb1a19e1973f2ed496fc.id: Taruh koma setelah fronted adverbial atau klausa pembuka (opening clause).

6afb24c2faf8a995c438.en: Put commas around extra information in the middle of a sentence.
6afb24c2faf8a995c438.id: Taruh koma di kedua sisi informasi tambahan yang ada di tengah kalimat.

0567e39a26431dc67dd7.en: Brackets can also hold extra information. The sentence must make sense without it.
0567e39a26431dc67dd7.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) juga bisa memuat informasi tambahan. Kalimatnya harus tetap jelas tanpa informasi itu.

b9902e2c88814cc54a4f.en: A comma in the right place can change the meaning, so read your sentence aloud.
b9902e2c88814cc54a4f.id: Koma di tempat yang tepat bisa mengubah arti, jadi bacalah kalimatmu keras-keras.

3950b8d992791d921076.en: Who is six is extra information, so it goes in brackets. My brother loves dinosaurs still makes sense without it.
3950b8d992791d921076.id: Who is six adalah informasi tambahan, jadi ditulis di dalam tanda kurung (brackets). My brother loves dinosaurs tetap masuk akal tanpa bagian itu.

4a3dc0b2833983b0e9ca.en: The brackets should close after six.
4a3dc0b2833983b0e9ca.id: Tanda kurung seharusnya ditutup setelah six.

3e39f0a5278958961d13.en: My brother is the main subject, so it should not be in brackets.
3e39f0a5278958961d13.id: My brother adalah subjek utama, jadi tidak boleh ada di dalam tanda kurung.

0e813d17109d68d59bc2.en: The brackets should hold only the extra information.
0e813d17109d68d59bc2.id: Tanda kurung seharusnya hanya berisi informasi tambahan.

3c4b474fdac13694b914.en: Before the bell rang is the opening clause, so the comma comes after rang.
3c4b474fdac13694b914.id: Before the bell rang adalah klausa pembuka, jadi koma (comma) diletakkan setelah rang.

eb30ba16943906da4476.en: In a list, commas separate the items, and the last two are joined with and: rice, eggs, chillies and bananas.
eb30ba16943906da4476.id: Dalam daftar, koma (comma) memisahkan setiap benda, dan dua yang terakhir digabung dengan and: rice, eggs, chillies and bananas.

13fc007460eb71c7fa3b.en: The comma should separate the items, not come after bought.
13fc007460eb71c7fa3b.id: Koma seharusnya memisahkan barang-barangnya, bukan ditulis setelah bought.

817c147e3e1b54c19232.en: There should be a comma after rice, and no comma after and.
817c147e3e1b54c19232.id: Seharusnya ada koma setelah rice, dan tidak ada koma setelah and.

81dde3132cfb6f747e77.en: There should be no comma after and.
81dde3132cfb6f747e77.id: Seharusnya tidak ada koma setelah and.

16445447923981b7c20b.en: After lunch is a fronted adverbial telling us when, so a comma follows it: After lunch, we played football.
16445447923981b7c20b.id: After lunch adalah keterangan di awal kalimat (fronted adverbial) yang menjelaskan kapan, jadi setelahnya ada koma: After lunch, we played football.

b7d2801fcd90b8355f44.en: We is part of the main clause, so it should not be separated from played.
b7d2801fcd90b8355f44.id: We adalah bagian dari klausa utama (main clause), jadi tidak boleh dipisahkan dari played.

506df7136dbab1fe6f9e.id: Played dan football harus tetap bersama.

9e9ad70be67754314fdc.en: The sentence ends after football, so it needs a full stop.
9e9ad70be67754314fdc.id: Kalimatnya berakhir setelah football, jadi perlu titik (full stop).

432345392669e7173657.en: Who is ten is extra information. The sentence still makes sense without it: My cousin Raka (who is ten) plays the drums.
432345392669e7173657.id: Who is ten adalah informasi tambahan. Kalimat itu tetap masuk akal tanpa bagian tersebut: My cousin Raka (who is ten) plays the drums.

36e89e4c37d6f13ab435.en: The extra information a huge temple in Central Java sits inside one pair of brackets, and the sentence makes sense without it.
36e89e4c37d6f13ab435.id: Informasi tambahan a huge temple in Central Java berada di dalam sepasang tanda kurung (brackets), dan kalimat itu tetap masuk akal tanpa bagian tersebut.

1578b8bea1007f86f495.en: There is one opening bracket but two closing brackets.
1578b8bea1007f86f495.id: Ada satu kurung buka, tetapi ada dua kurung tutup.

86635c5bd758a3321838.en: The brackets should go around the extra information only.
86635c5bd758a3321838.id: Tanda kurung seharusnya hanya mengapit informasi tambahan.

9941c58148929bd8f6c5.en: Borobudur is the main subject, so it should not be in brackets.
9941c58148929bd8f6c5.id: Borobudur adalah subjek utama, jadi tidak boleh ada di dalam tanda kurung.

97b2e525e89af36f5e75.en: Brackets add extra information. The sentence makes sense without the words inside them.
97b2e525e89af36f5e75.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) memberi informasi tambahan. Kalimat itu tetap masuk akal tanpa kata-kata di dalamnya.

9a52ceff215913444a08.en: Commas separate items in a list.

858dc8bb046c91215a82.en: The words in brackets are extra, not the main idea.
858dc8bb046c91215a82.id: Kata-kata dalam tanda kurung hanya tambahan, bukan ide pokok.

ffb1f2f24edcf2db79a0.en: In the correct sentences, the extra information our new neighbour and which was very ripe has a comma before it and a comma after it.
ffb1f2f24edcf2db79a0.id: Pada kalimat yang benar, informasi tambahan our new neighbour dan which was very ripe punya koma sebelum dan sesudahnya.

f8345e3993bc86f869cc.en: The commas should go before which and after ripe.
f8345e3993bc86f869cc.id: Koma seharusnya ditulis sebelum which dan setelah ripe.

486f22dab6b9369bc38c.en: The commas should go around our new neighbour.
486f22dab6b9369bc38c.id: Koma seharusnya mengapit our new neighbour.

dc98f90d743e0988750f.en: There is no extra information here, so no comma is needed.
dc98f90d743e0988750f.id: Tidak ada informasi tambahan di sini, jadi koma tidak diperlukan.

da622cc3a72eebcec37d.en: The correct sentences use a comma after an opening clause or adverbial and around extra information. The others put commas in places that split words that belong together.
da622cc3a72eebcec37d.id: Kalimat yang benar memakai koma setelah klausa pembuka atau keterangan (adverbial), dan di sekeliling informasi tambahan. Kalimat lainnya menaruh koma di tempat yang memisahkan kata-kata yang seharusnya bersama.

10db3bc33b674983d2c1.en: Although the road was flooded is a subordinate clause at the start, so a comma comes after flooded.
10db3bc33b674983d2c1.id: Although the road was flooded adalah anak kalimat (subordinate clause) di awal, jadi koma diletakkan setelah flooded.

6833ab1f66a9fd6ffdf4.en: The comma after washed shows that the first idea ends there. Without it, readers may think the children washed the dog.
6833ab1f66a9fd6ffdf4.id: Koma setelah washed menunjukkan bahwa gagasan pertama berakhir di situ. Tanpa koma itu, pembaca bisa mengira anak-anak memandikan anjing.

e0b535a0ddb531285f22.en: Without a comma, it sounds as if the children washed the dog.
e0b535a0ddb531285f22.id: Tanpa koma, kalimat ini terdengar seolah-olah anak-anak itu memandikan anjing.

3f4c357391fce0a8d7b3.en: A comma after After does not make sense here.
3f4c357391fce0a8d7b3.id: Koma setelah After tidak masuk akal di sini.

6406a262c886f9470fc5.en: The comma splits the children from what they did.
6406a262c886f9470fc5.id: Koma itu memisahkan the children dari perbuatan mereka.

36d0e6c6ae3c2cb7dbc0.en: The sentence needs three commas: On Saturday morning, Bu Rina, who is our school nurse, bought rice and chillies.
36d0e6c6ae3c2cb7dbc0.id: Kalimat itu perlu tiga koma: On Saturday morning, Bu Rina, who is our school nurse, bought rice and chillies.

fe26c643731c4fabafa9.en: A comma separates items in a list. The last two items are joined by "and", so no comma is needed there.
fe26c643731c4fabafa9.id: Koma memisahkan benda-benda dalam daftar. Dua benda terakhir digabung dengan "and", jadi di situ tidak perlu koma.

0771f3976b0b342a7ce4.en: "My cousin" is extra information about Tom, so it sits between two commas.
0771f3976b0b342a7ce4.id: "My cousin" adalah informasi tambahan tentang Tom, jadi ditulis di antara dua koma.

126e0d66607a8f8a37bc.en: "When the bell rang" is the opening part. A comma goes after it, before "the children ran outside".
126e0d66607a8f8a37bc.id: "When the bell rang" adalah bagian pembuka. Koma diletakkan setelah bagian itu, sebelum "the children ran outside".

58e991e3ba8b48675044.en: Lists have commas between items, openers have one comma before the main part, and extra information sits between two commas.
58e991e3ba8b48675044.id: Daftar punya koma di antara benda-bendanya, bagian pembuka punya satu koma sebelum bagian utama, dan informasi tambahan berada di antara dua koma.

647f3009224cfe05eb99.en: Extra information needs a comma before and after it. Without it the sentence still makes sense: "The river flooded the village."
647f3009224cfe05eb99.id: Informasi tambahan perlu koma sebelum dan sesudahnya. Tanpa informasi itu, kalimatnya tetap masuk akal: "The river flooded the village."

d9308f069fb2084cfb98.en: The second comma is missing after "wide".

b005342c6e9a2bf63eb6.en: The first comma is missing after "river".

c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.en: The comma is in the wrong place.
c6b5ff731aadbb06de98.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah.

3cc51ed162e150a387b9.en: Brackets hold a small detail, list commas separate items, paired commas wrap extra information, and a single comma ends an opening phrase.
3cc51ed162e150a387b9.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) memuat rincian kecil, koma dalam daftar memisahkan benda-benda, sepasang koma mengapit informasi tambahan, dan satu koma mengakhiri frasa pembuka.

5267d76b9f05b382464b.en: Correct brackets enclose only the extra detail, and the rest of the sentence still works without it.
5267d76b9f05b382464b.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) yang benar hanya mengapit rincian tambahan, dan bagian kalimat lainnya tetap masuk akal tanpa rincian itu.

e4d8abf0a569cef6946b.en: The puppy sentence uses brackets, and in the last sentence the extra information is "who is tall".
e4d8abf0a569cef6946b.id: Kalimat tentang puppy memakai tanda kurung (brackets), dan pada kalimat terakhir informasi tambahannya adalah "who is tall".

d7026619a481b948e36f.en: Stage directions tell the actor what to do. They are often written in brackets, so (She looks at the floor.) is the answer.
d7026619a481b948e36f.id: Petunjuk panggung (stage directions) memberi tahu pemain apa yang harus dilakukan. Petunjuk itu sering ditulis di dalam tanda kurung (brackets), jadi (She looks at the floor.) adalah jawabannya.

45e170c52a0739342f29.en: This is what Dewi says, so it is not a stage direction.
45e170c52a0739342f29.id: Ini ucapan Dewi, jadi bukan petunjuk panggung (stage direction).

f7afa5b00eec7a8dfa54.en: This is a spoken part and is not an action.
f7afa5b00eec7a8dfa54.id: Ini bagian yang diucapkan, bukan tindakan.

31253fc1bfb28409d196.en: The extra information "who had never swum before" needs a closing comma after "before".
31253fc1bfb28409d196.id: Informasi tambahan "who had never swum before" perlu koma penutup setelah "before".

7454e7c09adcc79238bb.en: Without commas, "Bayu" is needed to say which brother. With commas it would be extra, which suggests she has just one brother.
7454e7c09adcc79238bb.id: Tanpa koma, "Bayu" diperlukan untuk menyebut saudara laki-laki yang mana. Dengan koma, nama itu menjadi informasi tambahan, yang memberi kesan dia hanya punya satu saudara laki-laki.

841d2f66f1567efbe6c2.en: With commas, Bayu is extra information, which suggests she has only one brother.
841d2f66f1567efbe6c2.id: Dengan koma, Bayu menjadi informasi tambahan, dan itu menandakan dia hanya punya satu brother.

4a3f8bdd5ca0f18a3b5c.en: Brackets also show extra information, so this suggests only one brother.
4a3f8bdd5ca0f18a3b5c.id: Tanda kurung juga menunjukkan informasi tambahan, jadi ini menandakan hanya ada satu brother.

88daf24e706fbcd30b3d.en: The commas are in the wrong places.
88daf24e706fbcd30b3d.id: Komanya ada di tempat yang salah.

e3a06e3233acd3dc68c9.en: Brackets open before "football" and close after it, because the sentence still works without the extra word.
e3a06e3233acd3dc68c9.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) dibuka sebelum "football" dan ditutup setelahnya, karena kalimat itu tetap masuk akal tanpa kata tambahan tersebut.

0ffb1140cb9783cd3944.en: The bracket pair encloses exactly "which lasts a week", and the main sentence works without it: "The festival begins in June."
0ffb1140cb9783cd3944.id: Sepasang tanda kurung (brackets) itu mengapit tepat "which lasts a week", dan kalimat utamanya tetap masuk akal tanpa bagian itu: "The festival begins in June."

903952e0013c64998fa2.en: Brackets and commas together are not needed for the same extra information.
903952e0013c64998fa2.id: Tanda kurung dan koma tidak perlu dipakai bersama untuk informasi tambahan yang sama.

7df19b3480d7ebc0cc88.en: The bracket closes in the wrong place.
7df19b3480d7ebc0cc88.id: Tanda kurungnya ditutup di tempat yang salah.

b189dc008df11adc40f8.en: There is only one comma, so the extra information is not marked.
b189dc008df11adc40f8.id: Hanya ada satu koma, jadi informasi tambahan itu tidak ditandai.

721dd21c66fa4825fc9a.en: One after "ended", two around "who is a fisherman", and one in the list after "nets". That makes four.
721dd21c66fa4825fc9a.id: Satu setelah "ended", dua mengapit "who is a fisherman", dan satu dalam daftar setelah "nets". Jadi semuanya empat.

5650cb3864b1d5365c31.en: Commas separate list items. The last two items are usually joined with and.
5650cb3864b1d5365c31.id: Koma memisahkan benda-benda dalam daftar. Dua benda terakhir biasanya digabung dengan and.

b470df9f52ef22a2be2a.en: Speech marks show where speech begins. Brackets add extra information.
b470df9f52ef22a2be2a.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan tempat ucapan dimulai. Tanda kurung (brackets) memberi informasi tambahan.

9553fe99b4006af944a1.en: Brackets enclose extra information that is not essential to the sentence.
9553fe99b4006af944a1.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) mengapit informasi tambahan yang tidak wajib ada dalam kalimat.

e6605d462189ad1f93b7.en: Words in brackets are extra, so the sentence should still make sense without them.
e6605d462189ad1f93b7.id: Kata-kata di dalam tanda kurung (brackets) adalah tambahan, jadi kalimatnya harus tetap masuk akal tanpa kata-kata itu.

f2cd255eaf31c7186bc4.en: A pair of commas can mark off extra information in the middle of a sentence.
f2cd255eaf31c7186bc4.id: Sepasang koma bisa menandai informasi tambahan di tengah kalimat.

b0b1e5343385ab7528c0.en: A pair of commas is needed, one before and one after, just like brackets.
b0b1e5343385ab7528c0.id: Perlu sepasang koma, satu sebelum dan satu sesudah, sama seperti tanda kurung (brackets).

9218b4e563d71b5f785e.en: Brackets can hold extra information in a sentence.
9218b4e563d71b5f785e.id: Tanda kurung (brackets) bisa memuat informasi tambahan dalam kalimat.
